column1: # Rows db.pfo.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-1, 2026-11-17; fixtures make_multidb.py --pfoff-only): outfmt 13 to 16 of a list of a version 5 database with the accession table and one without it (multidb/pa ids/noacc_v5, multidb/na nnp) with PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1 BATCH_SIZE=1, so that a batch's prefetch is off and the report reads its subjects one by one: the lookup of a parsed Seq-align id of the database with the table walks the one without it and throws (CSeqDBException, `DB contains no accession info.`) at that query's first such `Hit`. NCBI's outfmt 15 and 16 (BlastJSON_FormatReport, BlastXML2_FormatReport) catch it: `Error: [<program>] ` and the exception's text, the query's report left out (its `,` separator stays), the next query goes on, exit status 0. Its outfmt 13 and 14 do not: the query's file stays empty and CATCH_ALL ends the run with `BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.`, exit status 2. `.second.` multidb/mix2_q* (the first query's report holds the database without the table alone, the second query's throws), `.first.` multidb/pfo_q* (those queries in the other order), `.tax.` multidb/pa put (na nut) with mix2_qc.faa (mix2_qcx.fna, mix2_q.fna, mix2_qt.faa) and BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/bad_magic: the text of the damaged taxonomy database that the loads of put's (nut's) subject open comes before NCBI's error, which the throwing subject's load (NCBI never makes it) does not follow. `.taxfirst.` the `.tax.` databases with the `.first.` queries (multidb/pfo_qf.fna, pfo_qft.faa for na nut, whose pfo_q.fna shows nut's copy of HBA1 first): the first query's report throws at its first `Hit` before any load reads the taxonomy database, so NCBI's text of opening the damaged taxonomy database comes at the second query's first loaded `Hit` (15, 16; 13 and 14 end the run first). `.taxstop.` the `.tax.` databases with multidb/pfo_qs* and a PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT between the Seq-aligns of the two queries: the first query's report (its batch's prefetch off) throws at its first `Hit` and never loads the subject with a taxid that it shows after it; the second query's batch prefetches, loads such a subject (NCBI's text of opening the damaged taxonomy database) and stops at a subject whose lookup throws (`BLAST Database error`, exit 2; review 1 of item pfoff-1: LOSAT left the text out where it took the first report's subjects as loaded). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.tab.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-2, 2026-11-17; DECISIONS 62 (12)): outfmt 6, 7 and 10 of the same lists with PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1 BATCH_SIZE=1. NCBI's tabular formatter (a CBlastTabularInfo per query report) loads each row's subject in the try of its subject block where the field list has a field of it: the lookup throws, the catch pushes the Seq-align id onto sall* and ends the row's fields, and the row is written with x_ResetFields' values (slen, length, the counts and coordinates 0), the scores, and the ids, titles and taxonomy that the report's last loaded row set (Unknown, 0 and N/A before one); a field list that reads the subject only after that block (slen, the letters) throws outside any catch: the rows before, then `BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.` (exit 2). `.after` queries (multidb/mix2_qc.faa, mix2_qcx.fna, mix2_q.fna, mix2_qt.faa) have a report that loads a subject before those that throw; `.first` queries (pfo_q.faa, pfo_qx.fna, pfo_qf.fna, pfo_qft.faa) a report that throws at its first row, where NCBI stops at sacc and saccver (null pointer, exit 255) and prints an uninitialised staxid, which LOSAT refuses and no row freezes. Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.tab.{dflt.20,slen.20,org.18} and BLASTP's .btd.6, .mix.6, .mixslen.6, .zgo.6, .zstop.6, .staxid.6, BLASTN's .h1.6, .h1c.6, .btd.6 (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-2, its reviews' fixes, 2026-11-18): outfmt 20 runs NCBI's tabular formatter as 10 after the line of the field names; the organism report (18) leaves out each HSP whose load throws (the catch of x_InitTaxInfoMap) and goes on; the tables' names and the taxonomy records are read only for the subjects that a report loads, so a damaged taxonomy database's text of opening comes at the first loaded row (.h1.6, .h1c.6: multidb/pfo_qh.fna, a first query whose rows all throw) and an empty taxdb.btd is read only for those (.btd.6); `nident` alone reads a throwing subject only at a row with identities (.zgo.6: multidb/pfzq, the run goes on; .zstop.6: multidb/pfz, it ends at the second subject); a batch whose prefetch is off, then one whose prefetch is on (.mix.6, .mixslen.6: PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=20); a throwing row's kept staxid (.staxid.6). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.pw.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-3, 2026-11-18; DECISIONS 62 (13)): outfmt 0 and the query-anchored 3 with PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1 BATCH_SIZE=1. NCBI's description lines (x_GetDeflineInfo) catch the throw: the Seq-align id and `Unknown` (with -show_gis the id's FASTA form, no space), the scores as usual, nothing loaded. Outfmt 0's x_InitAlignParams looks up the first shown alignment's subject without a catch where its id is not local (GetDbType): where it throws, the run ends after the query's description lines with `BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.` (exit 2); otherwise each HSP of a throwing subject is `Sequence with id <accession without version, or the whole local id> no longer exists in database...alignment skipped` and the run goes on. Outfmt 1 to 4 look up every shown alignment's subject without a catch, so the run ends where any throws; -num_alignments 0 shows none. `.after` queries (multidb/mix2_qc.faa, mix2_qcx.fna, mix2_q.fna, mix2_qt.faa) have a report whose first alignment loads; `.first` queries (pfo_q.faa, pfo_qx.fna) a report whose first alignment throws. The nucleotide lists `na nnp` hold local ids only, so the nucleotide programs' `.first` and `.parsed`/`.gis` rows use loadord's parsed holders beside `ldan` (`ldpn ldrn ldan` with ../taxfilter/q.fna or q.faa, whose first alignment is `NM_000001.1`; `ldpn ldan` with ldo_e2.fna or ldo_e2t.faa, whose third query shows ldan's glob1 and then `NM_000002.1`), and `.local` the `.first` query on `na nnp` (pfo_qf.fna, pfo_qft.faa). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0. Added 2026-11-21 (reviews of the item): `.local` rows hold the `.first` query on `na nnp`; one row each of BLASTP's -sorthits 4 (`.sort`) and of a run whose first batch's prefetch is off and the second's on (`.mixed`, multidb/pfo_qm.faa, PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=12), of outfmt 1 (BLASTN), 2 (BLASTX) and 4 (TBLASTN) (`.anchored.<n>`), and of psiblast's second round (`.round2`, `.round2e`).

# Rows db.pfo.bp.pw.end.* and db.pfo.bp.tab.end.6 (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-3, review 3 N1, 2026-11-22; fixtures make_multidb.py --pfoff3-only): a report that ends the run where its batch's prefetch is off, before a later batch whose prefetch is on: NCBI's application ends at that report, so the later batch is never prefetched.

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.xml.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-4, 2026-11-23): BLAST XML (outfmt 5) with the prefetch off (PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1, with or without BATCH_SIZE=1). NCBI's XML formatter looks each Hit's subject up by its first Seq-align's id inside a try (s_SeqAlignToXMLHit); where the lookup throws (`DB contains no accession info.`), its catch writes Hit_id = the Seq-align id's FASTA form, Hit_def and Hit_accession `Unknown` and Hit_len 0, and each Hsp's catch (s_SeqAlignSetToXMLHsps) writes Hsp_num, the bit score, the score and the E-value, the four coordinates 0, Hsp_identity = the Seq-align's num_ident (-1 where it has none) and empty Hsp_qseq and Hsp_hseq, nothing else. The report goes on (exit 0) and nothing is written on stderr for it. The lists and queries are pfoff-3's (`.after`: multidb/mix2_qc.faa, mix2_qcx.fna, mix2_q.fna, mix2_qt.faa; `.first`: pfo_q.faa, pfo_qx.fna, pfo_qf.fna, pfo_qft.faa); NCBI's XML looks up the local Seq-align ids of `na nnp` too. `.parsed` uses loadord's parsed holders `ldpn ldrn ldan` with ../taxfilter/q.fna or q.faa; BLASTP's `.two` and `.mh1` multidb/pf3p pf3u with pfo_qe.faa (a thrown Hit of two HSPs), `.mixed` pfo_qm.faa (PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=12: the second batch's prefetch is on), `.tax` the taxed lists `pa put` and `na nut` with BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/bad_magic. Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.xml.zid.5 and db.pfo.<tag>.xml.scope.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-4, review 1 L1 and H1, 2026-11-23; multidb/zpP znP pq_z.faa nq_z.fna from the review's fixtures, multidb/gpP gnP pP pU nP nU pq_21.faa nq_21.fna pq_U1.faa nq_U1.fna from blastdb-ids R/mixdb and R/mixdb2/review1): `.zid` a thrown Hit whose HSPs have 0 identities (zpP's or znP's one sequence, which no letter of the query matches, -threshold 9; the unparsed pU or nU makes its lookup throw), whose catch writes <Hsp_identity>0</Hsp_identity>; `.scope` the list gpP pP pU (gnP nP nU) where pP's ref|NP_100001.1| fails its lookup and gpP's gi|5001|ref|NP_100001.1| holds that id: with pq_U1 (nq_U1) the holder loads after the throw in the same report and NCBI throws (`.u1`, frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0); with pq_21 (nq_21) it loads in the first query's report, NCBI's scope gives it for the second query's lookup, which is not made, and NCBI writes the holder's record there, which LOSAT refuses with the words of another sequence that holds the Seq-align id (`.21`, kind losat-rejection). BLASTP's `.tab.scope.21.10`: the same in outfmt 10, where LOSAT refused before with the words of a null pointer that NCBI does not have there (review 1, H2).

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.<kind>.held.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-4, review 2 H1, M1, M2 and L2, 2026-11-23; multidb/zzgpP vpP epP npN agN vnP enP from the review's fixtures (R/pfoff/p4/review2/db, made with makeblastdb 2.17.0 -parse_seqids), multidb/pq_2.faa from blastdb-ids R/mixdb2/review1): NCBI gives a held sequence for a failing lookup from its data loader by the Seq-align id's own handle for the whole run, and from its scope by another type or a weak match until the end of the query batch (of the run in outfmt 5); `.zz` a holder in a database that NCBI orders after the failing subject's (rows by name), `.weak` an unversioned id and its versioned holder, `.type` emb for ref, `.name` a name-only id and a holder of that name; `.b1` (BATCH_SIZE=1) the holder in the first query's batch, `.nb` in the same batch. Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; losat-rejection rows: NCBI writes the holder's record (exit 0).

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.pw.<case>.html.0 and .html.nd0.0 (line RG T4a2, 2026-11-23, decision T4a2-7): the outfmt 0 rows above with -html. NCBI's description row of a subject whose load throws makes its link in the catch of the row's load (x_GetDeflineInfo, showdefline.cpp:1588-1611), and that GetIDUrl loads the subject again with the scope (align_format_util.cpp:3904-3907): the run ends there, after the rows before it, with BLAST Database error and exit status 2. With -num_descriptions 0 the alignments are written as without -html (the headings of such a subject are the skipped lines).

# Row db.pfo.bp.pw.gi.html.nd0.0 (line RG T4a2 fix 1, 2026-11-23, review a N1, decision T4a2-6 corrected): -num_descriptions 0 -html where a subject whose load throws (pa's accessions, beside noacc_v5) ranks before one that loads by its gi (ldi's gi|1): NCBI's display loads the alignment's subject before it starts a heading, so the thrown subject starts none and the gi subject's links have blast_rank=2 (the local qp1 is 1).

# Rows db.pfo.bp.<kind>.lines.* and db.pfo.bp.<kind>.held.{gnl,gnla,lcl}.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-4, review 3 M1, M2 and L2, 2026-11-23; multidb/zmdpH enpF gnpF agpH zgpH llpF zlpH from the review's fixtures (R/pfoff/p4/review3/db), multidb/zmgpH from R/pfoff/p4/f4/db, made with makeblastdb 2.17.0 -parse_seqids): NCBI's data loader gives a sequence it loaded for the handle of an id of any of its definition lines, its scope one whose Bioseq holds an id it takes for the failing one or matches weakly, and that Bioseq has the ids of the line its load was made by (the line of its own Seq-align id); `.lines` a holder with two lines, `.gnl` and `.lcl` holders of a general and a local id, `.gnla` the holder after the failing row, with outfmt 0 and -html (whose run ends at the first thrown description row). Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; losat-rejection rows: NCBI writes the holder's record (exit 0).

# Rows db.pfo.bp.<kind>.lines.{acc1gi2,gi3,gi2x,giafterref}.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-4, review 4 L3, 2026-11-23; multidb/zq7pH zq3pH zq6pH zq8pH from the review's fixtures (R/pfoff/p4/review4/db, made with makeblastdb 2.17.0 -parse_seqids)): which definition line of a holder NCBI's scope holds (the line of its own Seq-align id: the first with a gi, else the first line) where the id of the failing lookup matches only another line (acc1gi2: the accession on line 1, the gi on line 2; gi3: the gi on line 3; gi2x: two gis; giafterref: a gi after a ref on its line). Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; the losat-rejection row: NCBI writes the holder's record (exit 0).

# Rows db.pfo.<tag>.thr.* (line DBID pfoff, item pfoff-7, 2026-11-24; tests/db_search/idlist/pw and nw, version 4 with parsed Seq-ids, make_idlist.py; queries idlist/pwq.faa and pwq.fna): subjects whose Seq-align id's lookup throws on the id itself (gnl|PIG|abc and gnl|BL_ORD_ID|zz, whose tags are strings: CObject_id::GetId(); gnl|ti|xyz, not a number). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 gives such a subject no Bioseq with the prefetch on or off: its prefetch of the batch fails there (Warning: [<program>] Error pre-fetching sequence data) and the formats load the batch's subjects one by one, as with the prefetch off. Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (rc 0, and the pairwise report's exit 255 of the exception); the losat-rejection rows: NCBI's null pointer exception with its binary's addresses.
